name: browser_dialog
description: Inspect or handle a pending browser JavaScript dialog (alert, confirm, prompt, or beforeunload) that paused the active browser session.

action.description: What to do with pending browser dialogs. Use 'list' to inspect waiting dialogs and recent dialog history, 'accept' to confirm/submit, or 'dismiss' to cancel.

dialog_id.description: Optional dialog id from browser_dialog(action='list'). When omitted, acts on the most recent pending dialog.

prompt_text.description: Optional text to enter for a prompt() dialog when action='accept'.
